items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: And Mr. Zeissler was the owner there.

ctx.x: Lee, also wasn't your voice so clear and loud on certain occasions, for example, like at the Grand Theatre in St. Louis, where they didn't need a microphone for you?

Oh, yes. I was appearing there back in 1948, I believe, or 49, somewhere along that area. I was appearing to Grand Theatre in St. Louis, the burlesque show at 6th and Market Street in St. Louis, Missouri. And Mr. Zeissler was the owner there. And I was appearing there as a song and dance act. And they had a microphone there, and naturally I was using the mic as usual. And they came back and took the microphone away from me. And they told me I was the first singer that had been in there in fifteen years that…
We have about a minute left on this tape. I wonder if we can finish up on this. If there's anything else about the New Orleans musicians, or just the scene here in general, that you'd like to add?
